open_points.subject: public_op:source_folder.read_named_source
open_points.text: A ready `SourceFile` carries in `modified` the modification time A1 takes from the opened file, so its caller reads no metadata of its own.
open_points.question: What is the `modified` field of a rejected `SourceFile`: absent, present with null, or populated when opened-file metadata was successfully read before the rejection?
options: `modified` exists only on the ready variant
`modified` is optional and is null on every rejected value
`modified` is populated on rejected values whenever the opened-file metadata was obtained
open_points.default_guess: Make `SourceFile` a tagged value whose ready variant requires `modified` and whose rejected variant has no `modified` field.

witness.initial: A valid requested name identifies a non-empty regular file below the source limit whose read succeeds but whose bytes have an unsupported signature.
events: `module:source_folder` reads the opened-file metadata and bytes, then rejects the file under A1 order 6.
outcomes: The rejected value has no `modified` field because only a ready `SourceFile` carries it.
The rejected value carries the opened file's modification time because that metadata was successfully obtained.
witness.observer: `module:photo_delivery` and any generated type or serializer for `SourceFile`

open_points.subject: public_op:photo_preparation.prepare_photo
open_points.text: The bytes of the source, its modification time (`modified` of the ready `SourceFile` that came with those bytes) and the configured time zone.
open_points.rule: **Вывод импортов из текста — подсказка, а не источник.** Проектор локальной спеки находит кандидатов в импорт по тексту: имя чужого экспорта, встреченное **целым словом** в позитивном тексте notes или в тексте contracts consumer-а, и модели context closure. Каждый такой символ, не объявленный в `module_internal`, отчёт проектора (`python -m tools.slicer report --spec <base spec>`) называет находкой `SLICE_IMPORT_UNDECLARED` (repair_class `spec`): его объявляют в `module_internal` или убирают потребность в нём
open_points.question: Rewrite the input passage without naming the foreign `SourceFile` export, since this operation receives the modification-time value rather than that model, or add `SourceFile` to the declared `photo_preparation` → `domain_models` import surface if the operation actually names it.
